newsitem.title: UK: Brit-Borneo gains on Gulf of Mexico talk.
newsitem.headline: Brit-Borneo gains on Gulf of Mexico talk.

text.p: Shares in British-Borneo Petroleum Syndicate Plc gained 60 pence to 1,310p amid market talk the oil exploration company had increased its presence in the Gulf of Mexico.
One analyst said British-Borneo had picked up 15 blocks in a new, highly competitive lease round.
"That is driving the stock at the moment," he said.
No-one was immediately available at British-Borneo to comment.
British-Borneo is already active in the Gulf of Mexico, where its plans to develop its deep water Morpeth field.
High hopes for the field's potential have fired British-Borneo 63 percent ahead since the start of the year.
